- Ben has blue.
- Cara has yellow.
Agent B clues:
- Ben does not have green.
- Cara does not have blue.
- Dan has red.

- Dan does not have blue.
- Alex has blue.

Return one item assignment for every entity.
Use only the supplied clues.
response:

| Entity | From Agent A | From Agent C |
|--------|--------------|--------------|
| Alex   | green        | blue         |
| Ben    | blue         | –            |
| Cara   | yellow       | –            |
| Dan    | red          | –            |

All other clues are compatible with these assignments (e.g., “Ben does not have green”, “Cara does not have blue”, “Dan does not have blue”).  

The only conflict is that **Alex is forced to be both green and blue simultaneously**, which is impossible because each entity can have only one item. Since the set of supplied clues contains a direct contradiction, there is no way to assign a unique item to each entity that satisfies every clue.
